cues: The endocrine system is the slow but far reaching control system.
Ductless glands pour hormones into the blood, which carries them to any cell with the right receptor.
Slower than nerves, but the effects last much longer.
Peptide hormones like insulin bind a receptor on the surface and work through a second messenger such as cyclic A M P; steroid hormones pass straight through the membrane and act on the genes.
